name: PT Saptausaha Gemilangindah Tbk
summary: PT Saptausaha Gemilangindah Tbk develops and sells residential and commercial real estate properties in Indonesia. It operates through Property, Planning Services, Building and Environmental Management, and Internet Service provider segments. It also engages in the provision of management and consulting services; and operates as an internet service provider. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia. PT Saptausaha Gemilangindah Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Fort Terang Sejahtera.
